name: Field Medics
text: At the start of your turn heal each of your champions in play by 10HP

name: Enchanted Forest
text: At the start of your turn gain 1 Mana for each one of your active champions.

name: Battlements
text: If your fortress is attacked by a champion prevent 20 damage being done to the fortress and do 20 damage to that attacking champion.

name: Siege Works
text: At the start of your turn do 10 damage to the enemy fortress for each of your active champions.

name: Mist of Grief
text: For every champion you lose (to an attack, poison, a spell or recoil) gain 1 mana. Sacrificed champions do not count.

name: Super Shrink
text: All your opponents active champions have their HP reduced by 20
